rationale: The sole substantive ground-truth concern (yenuo26's inline comment asking whether the reduce_scatter parameter needs verification in the hasattr-only test) is hit almost exactly by Y's comment #6, which cites the same lines (121-126), names the reduce_scatter lambda, and explains precisely why the test validates the mock rather than production code. X's closest analog (test:92) argues for spying on use_device_communicator instead, a related but distinct concern, giving weaker recall. Y's other findings are deep, specific, and internally consistent (rank-asymmetric CFG hang risk, dead all_gather_object branch, data_parallel_rank never set, vestigial teardown guards), each with concrete fixes. X's report is bloated with duplicated near-identical findings about the same cfg_parallel_size>1 removal (three separate bullets, two with broken '?:882' location placeholders) and truncated 'additional observations,' which drags down both precision and actionability despite some individually valid points.
